# What is a Reproducible Analytical Pipeline (RAP)?

## In one minute

A Reproducible Analytical Pipeline, or RAP, is an automated process for producing statistics or analysis.

A RAP brings together:

- data;
- code;
- quality checks;
- documentation; and
- outputs.

The aim is to create a process that is reproducible, auditable, efficient and easy to quality assure.

::: {.callout-important}
## The core idea

A RAP replaces repeated manual activities with a process defined in code.

The code records what the process does. Version control records how the process has changes. Automated checks help people confirm that the process and its outputs are working as expected.
:::

## From data to a statistical output

A RAP is a sequence of steps that turns source data into a statistics product.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A["Source data"] --> B["Validate"]
  B --> C["Clean and transform"]
  C --> D["Quality assure"]
  D --> E["Disseminate"]
```
